seo_title: French Natural Red Khaprail Roof Tiles
meta_description: French khaprail tiles in natural red clay: an interlocking roof tile for houses, villas and commercial roofs. Made in Lahore, free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These French khaprail tiles are interlocking roof tiles in natural red fired clay, made by Pak Clay in Lahore for houses, villas and commercial roofs that want a classic tiled look.

## How they look
The French profile has ridges and channels pressed into each tile, and the edges lock into the next one, so a finished roof shows tidy, regular lines. The colour is the warm red of the fired clay itself rather than a coating, and like most natural clay it tends to mellow slowly with weather.

## Where they work
- **Pitched house and villa roofs** that want a traditional red roof.
- **Commercial and institutional buildings**, such as schools, resorts and restaurants.
- **Porches, verandas and gate canopies** that match a main roof.

Interlocking clay roof tiles are designed to channel rainwater along their ridges, and a ventilated clay roof is a long-standing way to keep sun off the slab below in hot Pakistani summers.

## Good to know
- Material: natural red fired clay (unglazed)
- Profile: French (interlocking)
- Category: khaprail roof tiles
- Size, coverage per square foot and ridge pieces: confirm on enquiry

Red clay roof tiles depend on correct slope, battens and overlap; have your roofer confirm these, and see our guide to [roof leakage with khaprail tiles](/blog/roof-leakage-with-khaprail-tiles-causes-and-how-to-fix-them) for what to check. For other profiles, compare [Spanish, French and flat khaprail](/blog/spanish-french-and-flat-khaprail-tiles-which-profile-suits-your-roof).

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the natural red khaprail colour and fit, then send your roof area and city for a dated quote. Want colour? See the [French green glazed khaprail tile](/products/french-green-glazed-khaprail-tiles), or browse all [khaprail tiles](/categories/khaprail-tiles).
ai_summary: Pak Clay's French natural red khaprail tile is an unglazed fired clay roof tile with an interlocking French profile, made in Lahore. It suits house, villa and commercial roofs, with free samples on WhatsApp and showrooms in Lahore and Islamabad.

faqs.q: What is the price of French khaprail tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the roof area, ridge pieces, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are French khaprail tiles good for rain?
faqs.a: The French profile is designed to channel water along its ridges and interlock at the edges. Whether a roof stays dry still depends on slope, overlap, underlay and fixing, so have your roofer confirm these for your building.

faqs.q: French or Spanish khaprail: what is the difference?
faqs.a: French tiles are flatter with pressed ribs and interlocking edges, giving neat lines. Spanish tiles have a deeper curved S or barrel shape and a wavier Mediterranean look. Compare samples on your roof design before choosing.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "French Natural Red Khaprail" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
